name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based push notification service that lets you send notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.

env.label: Base URL
env.description: Public-facing base URL of your ntfy instance (e.g. https://ntfy.example.com)

env.label: Upstream Base URL
env.description: Upstream server URL for forwarding push notifications to Firebase/APNs

env.label: Behind Proxy
env.description: Set to true if ntfy is behind a reverse proxy to trust X-Forwarded-For headers

env.label: Default Access
env.description: Default access permission for unauthenticated users

env.label: Enable Login
env.description: Enable the login page in the web UI

env.label: Enable Signup
env.description: Enable user self-registration via the web UI
